subject: Fix covariance/correlation matrix to values from previous calibration in mirt models

messages.author: 3a176c26aaba8d2d
messages.subject: Fix covariance/correlation matrix to values from previous calibration in mirt models
parts:
Hi Phil,

quick question, is it possible to fix the covariance/correlation matrix in a mirt model to those found in an earlier calibration (or perhaps found for a different group), in order to fix the latent trait space? So setting the means of all traits to 0, variances to 1, and correlations to previously found values, and then freely estimate the discrimination and d-values (in the GRM)?

Best,

Dirk

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: Fix covariance/correlation matrix to values from previous calibration in mirt models
parts:
There's lots of ways to do this, including approaches using the mirt.model syntax, but you may find it most easy to work with the data.frame of starting values directly. 

https://groups.google.com/forum/#!searchin/mirt-package/pars$20$3D$20$27values$27%7Csort:date/mirt-package/QZbzozxO9H0/KEF9xJ4NBAAJ

Phil
